A new Counterpoint Research report shows that Apple, Garmin, and Huawei grew against the overall decline in smartwatch shipments in the second quarter of 2026, with Huawei setting a new high in global shipment share. Details are as follows.

Apple recorded growth across all regions

A latest report released yesterday by Counterpoint Research indicated that global smartwatch shipments in the second quarter of 2026 fell 4% year-on-year.

The report noted that Apple's shipments grew 14% year-on-year, making it the brand with the largest increase, accounting for 20.1% of global smartwatch shipments, continuing to rank second behind Huawei. Huawei's shipments grew 1% year-on-year, with a market share of 21.8%.

Next in the ranking was Imoo, which, despite a 3% year-on-year decline in shipments, maintained a 7.8% share; followed by Xiaomi with a 6.1% share, but shipments plummeted 38%. Garmin's shipments grew 11%, accounting for 5.6% share; the remaining brands collectively accounted for the remaining 38.5% share, with shipments falling 8% year-on-year.
